received.name: graph_affected
received.description: Reverse traversal: what depends on this node and would be affected by changing it. Use before a risky edit.

received.name: graph_explain
received.description: Plain-language explanation of one node and its neighbours.

received.name: graph_query
received.description: Ask the graphify knowledge graph of this project a question (BFS over code, docs and their relationships). A few hundred tokens instead of a file walk. Requires graphify-out/graph.json.

received.name: harness_bench
received.description: Measure what atlias costs on this project and what a graph answer replaces: the session brief in tokens, a graph answer against the files it names, and how often the guard and the gate have interrupted. Reads only; calls no model. Use when asked whether the harness is worth its cost.

questions.description: codebase questions to measure the graph against

received.name: harness_digest
received.description: show: the session digests waiting to be consolidated into memory. ack: mark them consolidated after you saved the durable facts with harness_remember.

received.name: harness_progress
received.description: get: read the handoff note (objective, changed files, checks, next step). set: record the next step so a compaction, crash or new session picks up exactly here.

received.name: harness_recall
received.description: Search the shared memory (all hosts), recent session digests and the knowledge graph for a question. Cheap; use before reading files or asking the user to repeat themselves.

cwd.description: project directory (defaults to the server cwd)

received.name: harness_remember
received.description: Save one durable fact to the shared memory as a Claude Code memory file (name, type user|feedback|project|reference, description, body) and index it. Use for preferences, corrections, decisions and references, never for what the code already says.

received.name: harness_status
received.description: Health of the harness and its host integrations, with a fix for every failing check.

received.name: harness_verify
received.description: Syntax-check changed files (JavaScript, JSON, Python). Returns what failed and how to fix it.
